title: Computational Measurement of Political Positions: A Review of Text-Based Ideal Point Estimation Algorithms

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic review and categorization of computational text-based ideal point estimation (CT-IPE) algorithms into four families (word-frequency, topic modeling, word embedding, and LLM-based approaches) used to infer latent political positions, partisanship, and ideological leanings from textual data.
